title: OrganizationUnit
description: TOGAF-sourced structural archetype — human organizational structure (department, division, team, committee). An active system: people perform business functions (Mechanisms), produce decisions/outputs (Effectors), receive mandates/inputs (Receptors). Extends Structure with TOGAF Business Architecture vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Organization Unit (Content Metamodel, Business Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Business Architecture, Content Framework).

unitType.description: Organizational unit classification. TOGAF mapping: Organization Unit type in organizational decomposition.

level.description: Organizational level in governance hierarchy. TOGAF mapping: organizational governance tier.
